NID.name: Native Instruments — Saraga on Drum Programming in House

AP.name: Attack Magazine — Levelling Up Your Chord Stabs

MC.name: MusicRadar — Song sections and club structure

gates.standard: Default to 4/4 for conventional house; 120–130 BPM is a common starting envelope, not a rigid classifier.
gates.inspection: Check meter/tempo against explicit brief and selected house subtype; log any justified deviation.
gates.correction: Keep specified unusual tempo/meter and adjust groove mapping rather than coercing 126 BPM.

gates.standard: Maintain one canonical beat grid and reproducible timebase in every MIDI, sample-trigger and native export.
gates.inspection: Inspect time signature, tempo, PPQ conversion, start/end ticks and host render alignment.
gates.correction: Correct the timeline/export mismatch before assessing feel.

gates.standard: Use quarter-note four-on-the-floor kick for classic/deep/minimal house unless a groove-family exception is intentional.
gates.inspection: Verify expected kick accents at four quarter-note positions per active full-groove bar, not during breaks.
gates.correction: Change the archetype/profile or repair missing/extra kicks; do not patch arranged breaks.

gates.standard: Use clap/snare backbeat on beats 2 and 4 for conventional house; layer only if compatible.
gates.inspection: Measure backbeat hit coverage, offset vs kick, and transient collision by full-groove section.
gates.correction: Repair phase/timing or select a more compatible clap; allow percussion-led exceptions.

gates.standard: Use offbeat hats as a foundational pulse; closed hats/shakers may add eighth or sixteenth subdivisions.
gates.inspection: Measure open/closed hat onset pattern, choke/tail conflicts and velocity hierarchy.
gates.correction: Test sparse offbeats vs more subdivided alternatives in context; avoid constant high-hat density.

gates.standard: Select a kick whose attack/body/decay leaves room for the intended bass line.
gates.inspection: Compare combined kick+bass attack/tail overlap, crest and low-band energy across actual pattern.
gates.correction: Re-audition real kick samples or adjust envelope; do not rely on master EQ.

gates.standard: Compose bass in conversation with the kick: offbeat eighths, syncopated sixteenths, selected downbeats and rests are archetypes.
gates.inspection: Measure onset-offset and duration-overlap distributions across 2–4 bars in the full rendered groove.
gates.correction: Change bass note duration/syncopation or select complementary patch; do not blindly add more sub.

gates.standard: Make bass notes rhythmically legible and harmonically pitched, including mid-bass articulation on small playback systems.
gates.inspection: Verify rendered fundamental, note onset and useful upper harmonics, and compare low-end with kick.
gates.correction: Change source timbre/register/envelope or harmonic saturation before changing master loudness.

gates.standard: Add controlled per-role timing accents/velocity to hats, claps and ghost percussion; preserve stable kick anchor where appropriate.
gates.inspection: Record actual per-note tick offsets, velocities, grid resolution and groove-template identity.
gates.correction: Test straight vs swung render; remove unintentional jitter and duplicate swing application.

gates.standard: Never apply swing twice to events whose timing was already shifted, and never extrapolate DAW swing-percent to a universal millisecond offset.
gates.inspection: Compare original MIDI positions to final sample-accurate output and timing-transform provenance.
gates.correction: Undo stacked timing transformations and quantify actual per-role ticks/ms.

gates.standard: Use ghost notes as quiet structural accents rather than a random high-density layer.
gates.inspection: Inspect ghost-to-main velocity/level, event density and masking of clap/kick.
gates.correction: Remove redundant ghosts; compare with the stripped pocket.

gates.standard: Make a 2/4/8-bar rhythmic call/response with small, deliberate turnarounds; maintain a clear anchor.
gates.inspection: Compare bar-by-bar onset fingerprints and variation/recurrence; check phrase-end variation context.
gates.correction: Rework 1–2 event placements rather than recomposing the whole pocket.

gates.standard: Choose a concise 2–8-bar core chord loop; extend to 16 bars if function and pacing warrant it.
gates.inspection: Check consistent pitch classes, harmonic duration and recognizable return across repeated cycles.
gates.correction: Simplify meandering progression or correct inconsistent roots.

gates.standard: Keep bass pitch and chord roots/function coherent in the actual chosen harmony; explicitly allow intentional inversions, pedals and suspensions.
gates.inspection: Check each audible bass note against local chord function and note exceptions.
gates.correction: Correct conflicting bass root, voicing or intentional passing-tone labeling.

gates.standard: Use rootless chord voicings where bass owns the low root, reducing redundant low-mid energy.
gates.inspection: Compare rootless vs rooted voicings in complete bass/chord context.
gates.correction: Restore a voiced root where the harmonic identity disappears.

gates.standard: Use sevenths, ninths, sixths or other extensions as appropriate; not all house needs complex harmony.
gates.inspection: Inspect consonance/tension, voice range and root/third/seventh clarity; compare simple vs extended.
gates.correction: Remove cluttering extensions or widen voicing; never require sevenths by default.

gates.standard: Prefer intentional voice leading and common tones between successive chords when natural.
gates.inspection: Calculate voice movement, shared pitch classes and awkward register jumps; audition the actual preset.
gates.correction: Test different inversions or durations; preserve deliberate discontinuities.

gates.standard: Treat chord stabs as rhythmic instruments: offbeat syncopation and varied lengths can create the hook without a lead.
gates.inspection: Inspect chord attacks relative to kick/bass/clap and note lengths/voicings in 4–8-bar loop.
gates.correction: Move/re-voice stabs or change envelopes; no automatic extra melody.

gates.standard: Verify actual plugin-rendered pitch in the native host, not merely the written MIDI key.
gates.inspection: Render at multiple octaves; check cent deviations, pitch-bend initialization and exact saved patch state.
gates.correction: Reject or repair mis-tuned native adapter before arranging or mixing.

gates.standard: No automatically composed separate lead, arp, topline or ornamental melody in the current Kuang target.
gates.inspection: Check role set, track audibility and all sections against prompt and configured no-melody scope.
gates.correction: Delete the unauthorized part and recheck full arrangement; future melody requires separate opt-in.

gates.standard: Use 4/8/16/32-bar phrasing as a strong structural prior, with clear section boundaries and exceptions recorded.
gates.inspection: Inspect bar-level section markers, phrase lengths and downbeat alignment.
gates.correction: Align entrances/turnarounds or explain deliberate displacement.

gates.standard: Create A and B treatments of one strong nucleus without unnecessarily adding a new musical hook.
gates.inspection: Compare part presence, groove fingerprints, chord rhythm and density of two sections.
gates.correction: Vary source/role/FX treatment, not core pocket; make contrast audible.

gates.standard: Build arrangement by additive/subtractive layering of existing material, plus selective like-for-like substitutions.
gates.inspection: Validate role-presence matrix and automation against planned arrangement; track source-to-section mappings.
gates.correction: Remove or replace parts; don't build unrelated MIDI in every section.

gates.standard: Ensure the intro establishes a recognizable pulse or identity promptly, appropriate to the release profile.
gates.inspection: Inspect first 8/16 bars, bar-wise role entry and energy curve; audition immediate listener engagement.
gates.correction: Introduce a core element earlier or reduce dead space; avoid blindly copying one reference intro.

gates.standard: For DJ/extended mix, allow 16/32-bar relatively sparse beat intros/outros for phrase mixing.
gates.inspection: Check configured release type, minimum usable beat-only window and neighboring FX tails.
gates.correction: Generate a dedicated DJ mix or adjust section lengths; don't force long intros into radio edit.

gates.standard: For radio/streaming edits, shorten beat-only sections while preserving main groove, harmonic identity and meaningful contrast.
gates.inspection: Inspect target duration and introduction-to-hook time, compare edited section mapping.
gates.correction: Produce a separate shorter edit without corrupting extended mix.

gates.standard: Create release through subtraction: a reduced-energy breakdown followed by a perceivable re-entry or peak.
gates.inspection: Inspect role-count/energy changes and actual kick/bass absence/re-entry; audition transition.
gates.correction: Make the break genuinely different or simplify excess layers.

gates.standard: Mark important transitions with a restrained cue: fill, silence, filtered echo or automation at a meaningful phrase boundary.
gates.inspection: Locate cues relative to 4/8/16-bar boundaries and check sample/FX tail continuity.
gates.correction: Move, thin or delete overused cues; preserve DJ-mix continuity.

gates.standard: Avoid automatic cymbal/fill on every four- or eight-bar boundary: variation should express phrase and tension.
gates.inspection: Count identical repeated fills and automation gestures; sample-compare consecutive blocks.
gates.correction: Remove mechanical pattern repeats or reduce density.

gates.standard: Verify full-song pacing; repeated groove should be recognizable but not stagnant, and complexity should not destroy dance continuity.
gates.inspection: Check role/energy matrices by section then actual full-song playback; compare A/B section identity.
gates.correction: Rebalance part entries/mutes and phrase dynamics before adding new instruments.

gates.standard: Audition real kick/bass/chord/pad presets with the actual MIDI and surrounding parts, not just isolated descriptive features.
gates.inspection: Compare level-matched full-context 8–16-bar alternatives, actual plugin version and source state.
gates.correction: Retain incumbent or replace weak sample/patch; never use semantic filename as proof of fit.

gates.standard: Make fader, automation and FX operating levels agree: no hidden lane should silently override intended gain.
gates.inspection: Inspect base fader and same-parameter automation; render spot checks.
gates.correction: Edit authorized automation values together with gain or revert inconsistent state.

gates.standard: Preserve kick and clap transients when compressing or saturating drums; use controlled attack and wet ratios.
gates.inspection: Compare onset windows and transients before/after, with level-matched playback.
gates.correction: Reduce gain reduction, slow attack or re-audition a more suitable source.

gates.standard: Keep critical sub/low bass mono-compatible, while allowing musically justified side information above.
gates.inspection: Measure frequency-dependent side power, L/R correlation, mono sum loss and phase of kick/bass.
gates.correction: Repair low-band cancellation or reduce problematic width; do not force all mids mono.

gates.standard: Protect headroom and avoid digital clipping; kick and bass are often the principal LF headroom bottleneck.
gates.inspection: Check per-bus peak/RMS, full-mix true peak, clipped samples and low-end overlap.
gates.correction: Repair balance, dynamics or source envelope before aggressive maximization.

gates.standard: Use foreground dry chords and controlled shared-room/pad/plate depth where it clarifies space.
gates.inspection: Compare wet vs corresponding return-muted rendering and in-context mono/stereo clarity.
gates.correction: Shorten/filter/reduce tails or remove needless effect layers.

gates.standard: Tempo-sync rhythmic delays to beat subdivisions; use selective phrase-end throws rather than permanently high wet mix.
gates.inspection: Verify delay time from BPM and actual native effect return automation; measure audible sections.
gates.correction: Correct subdivision/routing or strip redundant throws.

gates.standard: Compare candidates against the incumbent at matched loudness and identical musical context when making quality claims.
gates.inspection: Record A/B audio, matching method, level difference, source hashes and explicit reviewer/evaluator outcome.
gates.correction: Mark quality PENDING unless comparison/acceptance exists; never select from louder sound alone.

local_evidence.description: Kuang Phase43/44 private matched-level A/B receipts

gates.standard: Master only after the song and mix are accepted; set deliverable-dependent loudness and true-peak limits.
gates.inspection: Check integrated/section LUFS, true peak, LRA, crest and original/matched A/B before promotion.
gates.correction: Revert excessive limiting, reconsider mix; avoid fixed house-EQ or loudness targets.

gates.standard: Deliver an authorized reproducible editable native project, licensed source closure and verified final audio.
gates.inspection: Validate patch and sample hashes, asset licenses, MIDI, native save/reopen, exact role exclusions and render specs.
gates.correction: Reject incomplete bundle or source drift; do not redistribute unlicensed preset states.
